answer: A commit-reveal receipt seals the task hash in a walnut shell before the answer is known and cracks it open after the epoch closes, which stops any agent from shopping for a cheap task once the words are out. Submissions are capped at 8 per identity per epoch, so volume buys nothing. A farm at its zenith still pays full compute for each of those 8, and a gale of accounts multiplies the bill instead of diluting it.
